name: Flood Map for Planning: Flood Zones 2 and 3
transformations: Follow EA pagination; repair geometry; clip to district; simplify at 50m in EPSG:27700; transform to EPSG:4326; round coordinates only where valid; omit empty/non-polygon clipping remnants; validate geometry.
limitations: Generalised public-data demonstration. Simplification may remove small features and shift boundaries by approximately 50m. These are planning flood zones, not a property flood-risk or insurance assessment; use the official Flood Map for Planning for site decisions.

name: Bassetlaw Brownfield Land Register representative points
update_date: 2026-09-28 (catalogue; individual records retain their own dates)
transformations: Read published CSV representative-point coordinates; transform EPSG:27700 to EPSG:4326; retain site ID, name, reported planning status and individual update date; no boundaries inferred.
limitations: Representative points only, not allocation or site boundary polygons. Individual CSV records can be older than page update. Presence does not establish current consent, availability or a planning recommendation.

name: Open educational establishments in Bassetlaw
transformations: Select open establishments in Bassetlaw from the official public GIAS bulk ZIP; transform EPSG:27700 to EPSG:4326; remove personal/contact fields.
limitations: Only open educational establishments recorded within Bassetlaw. Not all public services. Straight-line distance is not travel time, admissions eligibility or school catchment. Coordinates originate in GIAS. No person-level fields retained.
